Create a real invoice for an existing client in this workspace. client.description: Client name exactly as stored in Customers, or a client id.

query.description: Part of the client name or email.

actions.description: List this workspace's invoices, optionally filtered by payment status (by payment state), workflow status (draft, pending, sent, refunded, cancelled, on hold) and/or client name. payment_status.description: Only invoices with this payment status.

status.description: Only invoices with this workflow status.

client.description: Only invoices for this client (name or id).

actions.description: Record a payment received against an existing invoice, by invoice number or id. This writes a real payment record and updates the invoice's paid amount and payment status (unpaid → partially → paid); an amount above the outstanding balance is rejected. Navigates the page to the updated invoice so the user sees the new status. Returns the payment id plus the invoice's updated balance and payment status.

invoice.description: Invoice id, number (e.g. "42"), or number/year (e.g. "42/2026"). If a bare number matches more than one invoice, the call is rejected — pass number/year or the id.

ref.description: Payment reference, e.g. a wire or check number.
